title.narrative: LB - Strengthening LB HIVAIDS M&E System

description.narrative: On April 20, 2004, the Government of Lebanon (through the Ministry of Public Health), requested from the Bank an Institutioanl Development Fund (IDF)Grant to support its efforts at addressing the HIV/AIDS epidemic in the country. A detailed proposal has been submitted and reviewed by the Bank's Regional IDF Committee. The Committee has approved the amount $350,000 towards strengthening the National HIV/AIDS M&E and Surveillance systems in Lebanon. In light of this approval, the Country Department has allocated $20,000 to finance the grant processing and supervision for FY'05. The purpose of this IDF grant is to support the Government of Lebanon in developing an M & E (epidemiologic and programmatic) system that will be a source of information on performance for the public and for donors as well as to be a management tool for implementation agencies in the public and private sector, in civil society and for country coordination mechanisms. This grant will enhance the capacity of the Government of Lebanon to plan, manage and implement HIV/AIDS prevention, care and treatment, and mitigation programs in the country. The grant will finance 3 major components as follows: 1. Developing a National HIV/AIDS Monitoring and Evaluation System with participatory approaches; 2. Evaluation and strengthening of current HIV/AIDS epidemiological surveillance system; and 3. Devloping guidelines for integrated prevention and care for vulnerable groups. Outcomes of the Grant: 1. National M&E framework, indicators, operational plan and budget developed, reviewed by stakeholders and adopted by National AIDS Program and stakeholders; 2. Recommendations for upgrading existing surveillance system adopted by National AIDS Program & stakeholders; 3. Studies of effective interventions among prisoners, IDUs, MSM and CSW completed and findings are integrated into guidelines to be completed under Component 3; and 4. Guidelines adopted by National AIDS Program and stakeholders and integrated into National Strategic Plans. The grant objective is to assist the Government of Lebanon in developing an HIV/AIDS monitoring and evaluation (M & E) system (epidemiologic and programmatic) that will be a source of information performance for the public and for donors as well as to be a management tool for implementation agencies in the public and private sector, in civil society and for country coordination mechanisms. The grant is expected to enhance the capacity of the Government of Lebanon to plan, manage and implement HIV/AIDS prevention, care and treatment, and mitigation programs in the country.
